Welcome to Sports Massage Therapy Education!
Learn essential techniques, assessments, and injury prevention strategies to advance your skills as a sports massage therapist. I’m a qualified sports massage tutor with over 10 years of experience teaching learners how to build confidence, pass assessments, and deliver effective treatments.

Whether you’re a practising therapist or just looking to level up, this channel offers expert guidance and practical tips to help you succeed. This content is for therapists who want to improve their practice — it’s not a substitute for formal training. Use what you learn at your own risk (but don’t worry, we’ve got your back)!

🎯 Subscribe and start mastering sports massage today!
